name: ianhobbs-kirby-swiper-block
description: Kirby CMS layout block plugin — Swiper 12 carousel with panel editor

scripts.build: npm run build:panel && npm run build:frontend
scripts.build:frontend: esbuild src/frontend/swiper-block.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2019 --legal-comments=none --banner:js='/*! Bundles Swiper 12.2.0 (MIT) - https://swiperjs.com - Copyright 2019 Vladimir Kharlampidi. See assets/dist/LICENSE.swiper */' --outfile=assets/dist/swiper-block.js && esbuild src/frontend/swiper-block.entry.css --bundle --minify --legal-comments=none --banner:css='/*! Bundles Swiper 12.2.0 (MIT) - https://swiperjs.com - Copyright 2019 Vladimir Kharlampidi. See assets/dist/LICENSE.swiper */' --outfile=assets/dist/swiper-block.css
